run_prepare_emilia_dataset: run the Emilia dataset preparation script to process audio files and generate training data
process_audio_directory: process an audio directory to extract text, durations, and vocabulary from JSON metadata files
build_dataset_with_arrow: build an Arrow dataset from processed audio entries with text and duration metadata
generate_vocab_file: generate a sorted vocabulary text file from unique characters found in audio transcriptions
export_duration_statistics: export duration statistics as a JSON file containing all audio clip durations
